description: Capability for the Node setup screen (label `node-setup`), the bundled local page a first run with no usable Node stops at, and the startup error screen in its error mode. It needs exactly the six node_setup_* commands, none of which takes a string from the page. No core window controls (the shell shows, fades and closes it from Rust), no events, no shell:*, and no remote URL: it is a local page only.
